armies_of_renown.name: Petrifex Elite
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction for your army, you can choose for it to be a Petrifex Elite Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options box below. All units in your army gain the PETRIFEX ELITE keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
0-1 The Grand Necromystic (must be your general if included)
Mortisan Ossifector
Mortisan Soulmason
Gothizzar Harvester
Immortis Guard
Necropolis Stalkers
Morghast Harbingers
Mortek Crawler
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain.

battle_traits.name: Constructs of Petrified Bone
battle_traits.effect: Ignore the first damage point that would be allocated to each friendly PETRIFEX ELITE unit in each phase.

battle_traits.name: Relentless Onslaught
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly non-HERO INFANTRY unit that has been destroyed to be the target,
battle_traits.effect: Roll a dice. If the roll is lower than the number of models in the target unit, set up a replacement unit with half the number of models from the target unit (rounding up) in friendly territory, wholly within 6" of a battlefield edge and more than 9" from all enemy units.

battle_traits.name: Shattering Strike
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE unit that charged this turn to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: The target can use 2 FIGHT abilities this phase. After the first is used, however, this unit has STRIKE-LAST for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Ceaseless Advance
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE unit that is in combat to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: For the rest of the turn, no mortal damage is inflicted on the target by RETREAT abilities, but when the target uses a RETREAT ability, it must end the move closer to or in enemy territory.

entries.name: Plunderer of Parts
entries.effect: If any enemy models were slain by this unit's combat attacks this turn, roll a D3. On a 2+, Heal (X) this unit, where X is an amount equal to the roll.

entries.name: Titan's Fang
entries.effect: Inflict D3 mortal damage on each enemy unit in combat with this unit.

entries.name: Hard as Diamond
entries.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for attacks that target that unit until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Skeletal Grasp
entries.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
Until the start of your next turn:
• Halve the target's Move characteristic
• Subtract 1 from the number of dice rolled when making charge rolls for the target, to a minimum of 1.

entries.name: Tremors From the Entombed
entries.declare: Pick a friendly PETRIFEX ELITE WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a terrain feature or faction terrain feature within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect:
If the target is a terrain feature, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of it. On a 2+. inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.
If the unit is a faction terrain feature, inflict 2D6 mortal damage on it, If the target is destroyed, before removing it from play, roll a D3 for each unit (friendly or enemy) within 3" of it. On a 2+, inflict an amount of mortal damage on that unit equal to the roll.

entries.name: Summon Nightmare Predator
entries.declare: If there is not a friendly Nightmare Predator on the battlefield, pick a friendly OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD to cast this spell, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Set up a Nightmare Predator wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.

armies_of_renown.name: The Lance of Ossia
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Lance of Ossia Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the LANCE OF OSSIA keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Arch-Kavalos Zandtos (must be included and must be your general)
Liege-Kavalos on War Chariot
Kavalos War Chariot
Any OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS CAVALRY units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown or faction terrain

battle_traits.name: Praetorian Elite
battle_traits.declare: You must use this ability if there are any friendly LANCE OF OSSIA HEROES on the battlefield. Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA HERO to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: You gain a number of relentless discipline points equal to a number of shown after the target's RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE keyword. At the end of the battle round, any unspent relentless discipline points are lost.

battle_traits.name: Vengeful Outriders
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. Add 2" to the target's Move characteristic for the rest of the phase.

battle_traits.name: Kavalos Lance
battle_traits.effect: When a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit uses the 'Power Through' command, the target does not have to have a lower Health characteristic than that friendly unit.

battle_traits.name: Silent Menace
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to use this ability, then pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of it to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. The target cannot use the 'Redeploy' command for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Fury of Zandtos
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that charged this turn and that has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. The target's melee weapons, including Companion weapons, have Crit (2 Hits) for the rest of the turn.

battle_traits.name: Blood-smeared Hooves
battle_traits.declare: Pick a friendly LANCE OF OSSIA unit that charged this turn and has not used a RELENTLESS DISCIPLINE ability this phase to be the target.
battle_traits.effect: Spend 1 relentless discipline point. If the target is reinforced and has more than half of its starting models, spend 2 relentless discipline points instead. Add 1 to the Rend characteristic of the target's weapons, including Companion weapons, for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Prevailing Tactician
entries.effect: If a friendly Arch-Kavalos Zandtos is not wholly within 12" of this unit, you gain 2 relentless discipline points.

entries.name: Helm of Tyranny
entries.effect: Subtract 3 from the control scores of enemy units while they are within 12" of this unit.

armies_of_renown.name: The Null Myriad
armies_of_renown.text:
When you pick the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction for your army, you can choose for it to be the Null Myriad Army of Renown. If you do so, use the faction rules on these pages instead of the Ossiarch Bonereapers faction rules. Every unit in your army must be drawn from the units listed in the roster options below. All units in your army gain the NULL MYRIAD keyword.
ROSTER OPTIONS
Arkhan the Black, Mortarch of Sacrament (must be included and must be your general)
Any non-UNIQUE OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS WIZARD HEROES
Any non-HERO OSSIARCH BONEREAPERS INFANTRY units
You cannot include Regiments of Renown

battle_traits.name: Arcane Immunity
battle_traits.effect: Friendly NULL MYRIAD units have WARD (4+) against damage points inflicted by SPELL abilities, PRAYER abilities and abilities used by MANIFESTATIONS.

battle_traits.name: First of the Mortarchs
battle_traits.effect:
Each time you make a casting roll for a friendly Arkhan the Black, if all of the following are true, that spell cannot be unbound:
• The unmodified casting roll contains 2 or more results of the same value.
• The casting roll equals or exceeds the spell's casting value.
• The spell is not miscast.

battle_traits.name: Supernatural Absorption
battle_traits.declare: Pick an enemy MANIFESTATION within a friendly NULL MYRIAD unit's combat range to be the target.
battle_traits.effect:
Roll a dice. On a 3+:
• The target is banished and removed from play.
• If that friendly unit is damaged, Heal (X) that friendly unit, where X is the target's Health characteristic.
• If that friendly unit is not damaged, return a number of slain models to it with a combined Health characteristic of up to X, where X is the target's Health characteristic.

entries.name: Aura of Enervation
entries.effect: Subtract 1 from wound rolls for shooting attacks that target friendly NULL MYRIAD units while they are wholly within 12" of this unit.

entries.name: Gothizzar Cartouche
entries.declare: Pick a visible enemy unit within 12" of this unit to be the target.
entries.effect: Roll a dice. On a 3+, add 1 to hit rolls for combat attacks made by friendly NULL MYRIAD units that target that unit for the rest of the turn.

entries.name: Unearthly Aura
entries.declare: Pick a friendly NULL MYRIAD WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly NULL MYRIAD unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: Add 1 to wound rolls for the target's combat attacks until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Reinforce Construct
entries.declare: Pick a friendly NULL MYRIAD WIZARD to cast this spell, pick a visible friendly NULL MYRIAD unit wholly within 12" of them to be the target, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
entries.effect: The target has WARD (5+) until the start of your next turn.

entries.name: Summon Horror of the Necropolis
entries.declare:
Pick a friendly NULL MYRIAD WIZARD to cast this spell, pick 1 of the friendly MANIFESTATIONS below that is not on the battlefield, then make a casting roll of 2D6.
• Soulstealer Carrion
• Bone-tithe Shrieker
• Nightmare Predator
entries.effect: Set up the MANIFESTATION you picked wholly within 12" of the caster, visible to them and more than 9" from all enemy units.
